statement: The system shall understand different materials to utilize gripping features.
The system shall have a baseline configuration and support variants for project-specific requirements such as arm length, lifting capacity, and waterproofing.
The system shall have a variable viewpoint to look around.
The system shall have fixed camera views for specific tasks.
The system shall have an on-screen overlay to guide the user.
The system shall have high image resolution.
The system shall provide force feedback to the user.
The system shall have a ghost mode to preview the outcome of user commands.
The system shall have no-go zones to prevent damage in tight environments.
The system shall provide audio feedback, such as alarms, for different areas and situations.
The system shall allow programming for automated movement to a point where user control is required.
The system shall have teach files to create programmed paths.
The system shall be able to model the entire scene in simulation.
The system shall predict cable management.
The system shall have minimal latency.
The system shall have a high frame rate.
The system shall provide the user with a sense of trust in its operations.
